body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose two creatures within 5 units. On a success against an unwilling target, link them until your next turn; the first time one becomes Exposed or Dazed, the other also becomes Exposed.

surges.html: Choose one creature this Action succeeds against; make it Exposed.
If this card targets Composure, ignore 1 Defense.

rider.title: RESONANCE — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, when one linked creature moves voluntarily the other may move 1 unit.
